summary: Admit one expression-prefix transactional <p/q> literal and normalize it to an exact BigInt pair.
requires: the lexical goal is expression prefix
both components are contiguous unsigned decimal magnitudes
normalization completes within the deterministic budget
preconditions: expression-prefix goal is active
the candidate begins with < followed by a decimal digit
normalization: preserve raw CST magnitudes; reduce the mathematical BigInt pair by gcd, make the denominator positive, and canonicalize zero to 0/1
decision_procedure: probe the complete contiguous candidate without consuming on shape failure
validate unsigned decimal component spelling and absence of internal trivia
reject a zero denominator
normalize within the declared resource budget
emit one RationalConst with the normalized Rational TypeId
termination_metric: finite candidate byte length plus strictly decreasing Euclidean gcd magnitudes
evaluation_order: goal -> transactional scan -> spelling -> denominator -> normalization -> HIR

evaluation_order: scan -> normalize Rep -> classify operator -> select intrinsic/witness -> HIR

summary: Classify a proven synchronous ancestor-place read as a region-bounded lexical dependency rather than an environment capture.
preconditions: the capture list is absent or present-nonempty; a present-empty list is a closed ancestor-frame assertion, and explicit capture items remain orthogonal to residual lexical dependencies
the free use resolves to an admitted ancestor local or parameter place
the selected call/use graph supplies one exact bounded residence proof
normalization: deduplicate lexical dependencies by stable ancestor place identity and Read access while retaining use spans for diagnostics
decision_procedure: classify capture-list presence; reject a present-empty list before dependency formation, and retain a present-nonempty explicit capture plan independently
classify access and reject write, move, consume, snapshot, or unknown place state
reject guard, suspension, isolation crossing, or escaping residence
reserve one shared-read requirement for the invocation region
emit one lexical dependency row and zero CapturePlan items
termination_metric: finite callable body plus finite closed use graph
evaluation_order: capture-clause state -> access -> owner profile -> residence -> liveness -> HIR
